name: finish
calls: ReportAssertion(status='blocked' if blocked else 'inconclusive', expected=assertion, evaluated_at=at or now(), reason='A site or safety boundary prevented the declared state from being checked.' if blocked else 'No executed observation confirmed the declared filter state. Controller completion and count correctness remain separate.').model_dump

name: Refused
doc: The provider declined (Sonnet stop_reason refusal, GLM finish_reason sensitive). No schema guarantee.

name: Unusable
doc: Truncated, cut off or not the schema: never parsed into a step.

name: active
doc: The opted-in candidate, or None. A half-configured opt-in raises rather than silently running something else.

name: strict_schema
doc:
Claude structured outputs need additionalProperties false and reject numeric/length bounds; the bounds move
into the description and Pydantic still enforces them when the answer is parsed.

name: turns
doc: (role, text) pairs to Anthropic's system string and alternating user/assistant turns.

name: sonnet
doc:
Sonnet 5.5 on Google Cloud with native structured output. Per the migration guide: no sampling parameters,
no forced tool choice, no thinking budget; adaptive thinking (the default) with an explicit effort.

name: glm
doc:
GLM 5.3 over the general metered API with plain httpx. Thinking cannot be turned off; JSON mode has no schema,
so the schema goes in the prompt and Pydantic validates the answer.

name: legacy_fingerprint
doc: Title key used by reports and ignored findings written before rule ids.

name: fingerprint
doc: Prefer the stable rule id; old report rows still use the title key.

name: _unique
doc: A finding reported twice is one problem: keep the first of each fingerprint.

name: compare
doc:
Finding by finding, and page by page where the reports know the pages. A finding that vanished only because
none of its pages were audited this time is "not re-checked", never "fixed". So is a UX finding that vanished
from a journey that did not finish (R-S13): the test user may simply not have reached that point.

name: recheck_assertion
doc:
R-S13: the declared count check against its previous result, like for like. Rows carry report, persona and
logged_in. Missing coverage is "not_rechecked" and changed conditions are "not_comparable"; neither is ever fixed.
The dataset timestamp is fresh on every run by design, so it is not a changed condition.

name: attach
doc: The comparison for a finished paid run, or None (free plan, first run of this goal, or no user).

name: EmptyChapter
doc: A chapter prompt was requested for a chapter with no open findings.

name: recipe
doc: The recipe for a finding's rule: an exact id first, then the most specific matching pattern.

name: step
doc: The change for this stack: {file, snippet, note, lang, label} or None when only a text change or manual step exists.

name: plan
doc:
Findings grouped into batches (each item: finding, recipe, step) and the manual steps. Used by both prompt styles,
get_finding and the fix pull request. `section` keeps one report chapter's findings (R-S5a section prompts).

name: finding_lines
doc: Why, where, the change for this stack, the risk and the local check, for one finding.

name: build
doc: The whole plan, or one chapter's part of it when `section` names a chapter (a smaller prompt per chapter).

name: _where
doc: Every affected page when the report knows them (the evidence line shows at most 3).

name: _fix_for
doc: The GEO fix pack entry that solves this finding, if any.

name: _chat
doc:
Short parts for chat builders (Lovable, Bolt), each at most CHAT_LIMIT characters with its own header, in batch
order. Every finding is included: long plans become more parts, never "and N more".
calls:
'

'.join((head.format(i=i, n=total) + '
'.join(part) + (tail if i < total else '
') for i, part in enumerate(parts, start=1))).strip

name: _content_brief
doc:
Keywords and content (R-S17): a content brief kept apart from technical repairs. It reuses the page's own words
and asks for nothing that would add unconfirmed claims.

name: _authority_brief
doc:
Authority and backlinks (R-S17a): an owner's plan, kept apart from code repairs. A coding agent cannot create
genuine third-party links by editing a page, so this asks for briefs and inputs, never sends or publishes.

name: chat_parts
doc: Split a chat plan back into its parts (each starts with "Walkthru fix plan for").

name: metrics
doc:
Steps to the goal, fields typed, distinct errors seen, safe stops, and the first useful screen: the first step
that completed a checkpoint of the goal plan. Seconds come from screenshot times, so they are None without them.

name: plan
doc: One fast model call before the first step. A planner outage never blocks a test: the typed goal is used.

name: reached
doc: URL proof only for declared navigation, on the original origin and a newly reached route.

name: evidence
doc: Match a fresh milestone. Signals are scoped public UI evidence, not backend proof.

name: render_history
doc: Bounded factual context. Earlier proven milestones survive; values and persona narration do not.

name: build_graph
doc: Build the loop around either a decision provider or a structured-output LLM.

name: _confirmed
doc: Only code-confirmed evidence for every declared checkpoint finishes the task.

name: _site_block
doc: A current observed action failure, never persona narration or a refusal, can explain abandonment.

name: _lost
doc:
The run ended because Walkthru could not find the control it needed: in its last three actions the model
picked an element that was not on the page, or the executor could not find it. That is Walkthru's limit
(an unlabelled icon, a control the snapshot missed), not proof the site is broken.

name: _identity_value
doc: Test-identity value for a field, chosen from its label or input type.

name: _enforce
doc:
Code-level safety: replace unsafe or invalid choices instead of trusting the prompt.

Returns (step, stop code). A code means Walkthru ended the journey on purpose: safe_stop (a send or destructive
button) or visitor_mode_limit (a form or a social or commerce control on an unverified site).

name: Refused
doc: A run the policy will not start. `code` is the stop-reason code from the plan's section 11.

name: category
doc: The blocked category of this URL's host (the host itself or any parent domain listed), or None.

name: _normal
doc: Fold look-alike characters and drop invisible ones, so "l​ike" or full-width letters read as plain words.

name: check
doc:
Raise Refused when this run may not start. `verified` (the user verified `site`) is called only when the answer
depends on it, so the domain check keeps running in the background for ordinary runs. `start_url` is the page the
tested tab is on, which a modified extension could set apart from `site`.

name: signed_in_unverified
doc:
A visitor-mode run on a page that shows the user's own account (a sign-out control, an account menu).
`verified` is called only when the page looks signed in.

name: left_for
doc:
Mid-run: the category when the tested tab has reached a blocked host the user has not verified, else None.
A verified owner may stay on their own host even when it is listed.

name: stack_scan
doc: Which hosting, framework and backend the site uses, from one homepage response (P1.3).

name: site_scan
doc: Crawl once, then feed both SEO and passive-security report branches.

name: render_steps
doc: Each step with where it started, where it ended and what the page showed afterwards.

name: browser_findings
doc: Turn real-browser diagnostics into bounded, step-specific report findings.
calls: f"A single browser visit observed {labels[metric]} at {shown}; the good threshold is {good} {('ms' if metric != 'cls' else '')}. This is not a Lighthouse lab run or population field p75. No resource attribution was captured.".strip

name: problem_steps
doc: Observed page errors or unchanged clicks, never the agent's thoughts or termination alone.

name: grounded_ux
doc:
Keep only UX findings the journey supports: they must cite a step where something went wrong
and must not restate a scan finding. A journey where every step worked yields no UX findings.

name: mailer_findings
doc: A signup that failed on the auth provider's email sending limit, with the exact fix.

name: _prompt_text
doc: Mask provider secrets and browser-style PII before expanding evidence into a model prompt.

name: _prompt_values
doc: Bound selected measurement objects; callers select fields, never pass raw form values.

name: _evidence_prompt
doc: A valid JSON evidence block with a strict character budget and explicit truncation.

name: synthesis_inputs
doc: Everything the report writer is given, built from graph state. Shared by synthesize and model evals.
calls: {'safe_stop': 'stopped by Walkthru at the send button (by design)', 'looping': "stopped by Walkthru because the test user started going in circles. That is Walkthru's own limit, not a site problem; never report the repeated visits as a site problem", 'stopped': 'the journey stopped early; pending or interrupted actions were not confirmed and completion was not established', **{code: f'{STOP_REASONS[code][1]} Use this wording; never report it as a UX finding' for code in ('bot_wall', 'captcha', 'agent_lost')}}.get

name: plain
doc: House style for model-written text: no em or en dashes (models add them even when told not to).

name: _with_backend
doc: Retain public bundle discovery separately from actionable backend exposure findings.

name: also_affects
doc: Other chapters one shared cause also affects. Rule ids only: legacy findings without a rule get no cross-link.

name: chapters
doc:
Every chapter in order: number, key, title, status, label, plain-language summary and its issue ids.
`kind`/`status` are the run's; `ignored` findings stay listed but do not count as open issues.

name: next_actions
doc: The first actions to take: open findings by severity, then chapter order, then report order.

name: resolve
doc: A chapter key from user input, or ValueError naming the valid keys.

name: ReportContractError
doc: A stored report cannot be interpreted safely by this reader.

name: HybridPersonaModel
doc: Use Jev for bounded choices and the existing LLM whenever Jev abstains.

name: openrouter
doc: One OpenRouter model as a runnable, over plain httpx. A forced tool call returns the schema's JSON.

name: model_label
doc: Said in every report and pinned in run quotes, so the Claude selling point stays honest.

name: _haiku_only
doc: The legacy adapters send temperature 0 and a forced tool, which Sonnet 5.5 rejects: no name-only swaps.

name: claude
doc: Claude on Google Cloud as a runnable. A forced tool call returns the schema's JSON, like openrouter().

name: guarded
doc: Keep LangChain's fallback/config propagation while sharing health across models and schemas.

name: free_pool
doc:
Try each free model in order and move on instantly when one is rate-limited, overloaded or slow.

max_retries=0 everywhere: a 429 or 503 falls through to the next model in milliseconds instead of
sleeping on retry-after. reasoning_effort=low keeps gpt-oss from long reasoning spirals.
writer=True (report text, one call per run): truth beats speed, so the careful OpenRouter writer comes
right after the first Groq model (which the persona steps have usually rate-limited by report time).
Persona steps stay on the fast models only.

name: CandidateController
doc:
R-S11: a stronger controller candidate decides persona steps; on any failure the free pool answers that step
instead. Each step records which one answered and why, so a fallback never counts as a candidate decision.

name: unwrap
doc: Structured output with include_raw is {"raw", "parsed", "parsing_error"}; fakes return the object directly.

name: call
doc:
One LLM call returning (parsed schema instance, tokens used). fast=True skips the slow report writer
(used before a run starts, where the owner is waiting). paid=True puts Claude first when it is configured.

name: make_checkpointer
doc:
In-memory by default: zero network per agent step. Set CHECKPOINTER=postgres on a server that sits
next to the database (production) so runs survive restarts and the API can scale out.
calls: conn.execute('select max(v) as version from checkpoint_migrations').fetchone

name: initialize_checkpointer
doc: Fail startup before accepting requests if configured persistence is unavailable.

name: invoke
doc: Never replay a mutating graph invocation after losing its database acknowledgement.

name: get_state
doc: Reading is safe to retry once on a fresh pooled connection.

name: is_search_field
doc: The one field a visitor-mode run may type into: a site search box.

name: _context_text
doc: Extra contextual labels are untrusted visible text, never form values.

name: WebVitals
doc: Core Web Vitals observed in the real browser so far.

name: ScrollContainer
doc: An observed public scroll region, bound to the current observation revision.

name: Observation
doc: One page snapshot from the content script. PII is masked before upload.

name: EvidenceRegion
doc:
R-S19: where something was visible in this exact frame, as fractions of the captured viewport. Measured in the
same document just before capture and drawn over the image, never into it, so masking stays intact.

name: Pointer
doc: A point in a captured frame, as fractions of its width and height.

name: StepEvidence
doc: Private visual proof captured after one browser action.

name: PersonaStep
doc: What the test user thinks and does next. Exactly one action per step.

name: GoalPlan
doc: The owner's goal as intent plus an ordered checklist (app/agent/goal.py).

name: Finding
doc: One problem in the report. Deterministic scans and the synthesis LLM both produce these.

name: finding_rule
doc:
One stable id per check, including titles with counts, scores, paths or cookie names.

The known variable-title checks have explicit ids. Other deterministic titles
use a compact normalized slug; new findings therefore always carry an id.

name: FirstImpression
doc: What a stranger takes from the homepage in five seconds.

name: Synthesis
doc: The LLM's half of the report; code merges it with scan findings.

name: SiteAuditSummary
doc: Bounded crawl coverage included with new reports. Absent on legacy reports.

name: GeoSummary
doc: AI search readiness (app/scans/geo.py). Findings live in the report's findings list with kind "geo".

name: AssertionRecheck
doc: R-S13 (app/agent/compare.py recheck_assertion). Only like-for-like passed/failed pairs can read as fixed.

name: Comparison
doc: Against the previous run of the same goal on the same site (app/agent/compare.py). Paid plans only.

name: AgentReady
doc: Can AI agents use the site (P1.7, app/agent/score.py). Parts that were not measured are left out.

name: FilterCountAssertion
doc: One supplied synthetic UI expectation, never a data-fetch instruction.

name: _journey
doc:
Only a matching, supported assessment can establish completion or observed journey defects.

Legacy stop labels contain no completion proof. Keep their static measurements, but do not infer a journey
outcome. An interrupted run may still retain a genuine earlier browser-observed UX issue.

name: launch_ready
doc: {"score": 0-100 or None, "areas": {area: 0-100 or None}}. None means not measured.

name: agent_ready
doc:
{"score": 0-100 or None, "parts": [...]} from evidence the report already holds; never a model.

Parts: the journey reached its goal (25), no CAPTCHA in the way (15), fields and buttons with names an agent can read
(25), homepage forms fully labelled, with a bonus for WebMCP-declared tools (15), a WebSite SearchAction (10), and the
same journey working again on a rerun (10). A part with no evidence is left out, not scored as zero.

name: badge_svg
doc:
A 20px status badge for the owner's footer or README. Hex values mirror DESIGN.md tokens (ink, accent, muted,
danger) because the SVG renders on other people's sites, outside our CSS. Verdana keeps widths predictable there.

name: JevFallback
doc: The decision should be delegated to the existing generative model.

name: _history
doc: Keep navigation signal without resending generated text or narration.

name: _named
doc: A field an agent can identify: a <label for>, a wrapping <label>, aria-label, aria-labelledby or a title.

name: homepage
doc: {"forms", "fields", "named_fields", "webmcp", "search_action", "captcha"} for one page.

name: build
doc: The plan for one report, from its R-S17 page map. Legacy reports without a map get none.

name: lines
doc: The plan as text, shared by the Authority chapter prompt and MCP get_report(section="authority").

name: sources
doc: The homepage HTML plus up to five of its own script files: what any visitor's browser downloads anyway.

name: find_config
doc: Supabase project and keys, Firebase database and key, as they appear in the page's own code.

name: check
doc: Findings for the backend; optional public stack context contains no keys. Probes require verification.

name: parse
doc: One policy: directive name -> source list. The first occurrence of a directive wins, as in browsers.

name: policies
doc: Every enforced policy: the header may hold several (comma-separated) and <meta> tags add more.

name: _weaknesses
doc: title -> (severity, detail, fix, evidence) for one policy.

name: check
doc: Weaknesses shared by every enforced policy. Several policies all apply, so the strictest one decides.

name: domain_of
doc: The domain to check, or None when the site does not own its email DNS (local, IP, shared hosting).

name: check
doc: (findings, note). `full` (paid plans) adds the MX check. The note says why nothing was checked, if so.

name: is_public_ip
doc:
True only for a globally routable unicast address. IPv6 forms that carry an IPv4 address inside (mapped,
6to4, Teredo, NAT64) must carry a public one, or ::ffff:127.0.0.1 would reach this machine.

name: public_addresses
doc:
Resolve once. Every address must be public, and the caller connects only to these (DNS rebinding, SD-4.5).
ALLOW_LOCAL_SCANS=1 (fixtures) returns the name unresolved.

name: assert_public
doc:
Refuse hosts that resolve to private, loopback or link-local addresses: the early, friendly check. The pinned
connection below is what enforces it. ALLOW_LOCAL_SCANS=1 for fixtures.

name: _PublicOnly
doc:
Opens every connection of a scan client: resolves the host once, refuses any non-public address, and connects to
the checked address itself, so a second DNS answer (rebinding) can never be used. TLS SNI and the Host header still
carry the name, because httpcore takes them from the request, not from this socket.

name: _Release
doc: The response body, giving the host's slot back when it is closed (after a normal read, or a streamed one).

name: _Polite
doc: At most PER_HOST requests in flight to one host, so many users scanning one site at once never hammer it.

name: client
doc: The client for every request to a user's site. trust_env=False: an environment proxy would resolve the name again.

name: get
doc: Fetch with every redirect revalidated before the next network request.

name: page_text
doc: Visible text, whitespace-collapsed, the same shape the extension sends.

name: text_file
doc:
The body of a real text file (robots.txt, sitemap.xml), or None. Single-page apps often answer every path,
these included, with their HTML page and a 200, which is not the file.

name: is_js_shell
doc: True for single-page apps whose served HTML is an empty shell filled in by JavaScript.

name: is_local_site
doc: Local development servers: production transport, headers and speed cannot be judged there.

name: same_site
doc:
Same host, ignoring a leading www. and the scheme. Verification covers the host the owner proved, so a
redirect to another host must not carry the owner-only checks with it.

name: GeoResult.summary
doc: The part stored in `report.geo`; findings go to the report's findings list. Free reports keep one fix and the count.

name: _json_ld
doc: Every JSON-LD object on the page (expanding @graph and lists), and whether any block failed to parse.

name: audit
doc:
`pages` starts with the homepage. `full` scores every page (paid plans); otherwise the homepage only.
`local` skips checks that describe the host rather than the code (robots.txt and the bot probe on a dev server).

name: _wikidata
doc: Match a named entity by its P856 official website, never by a same-name search hit alone.

name: collect_remote
doc: Two same-origin discovery reads and optional free entity lookups. Failures never affect readiness.

name: analyze
doc: Per-page citation evidence plus bounded, explainable advisory findings.

name: site_name
doc: og:site_name, then a schema name, then the title before its separator ("Tripverse: plan trips" -> "Tripverse").

name: build
doc:
Fixes for what the GEO audit found, most valuable first. `objects` is JSON-LD from every audited page, `root_objects`
from the homepage only (the site's name comes from there). llms_ok is None when llms.txt was not checked.

name: _clean
doc: Drop build words the greedy version pattern swallows: 3.7.1.min -> 3.7.1.

name: at_or_above
doc: retire.js isAtOrAbove: dotted and dashed parts compared in order; a number beats a word (1.0 > 1.0-beta).

name: detect_url
doc: (library, version) named by a script URL or its file name.

name: detect_content
doc: (library, version) from banners and markers inside a script file.

name: _sort_key
doc: Order versions the retire.js way, for picking the highest fixed version.

name: _sentence
doc: The first sentence of page copy, cut at a word boundary. Quoted, never rewritten.

name: facts
doc: What one page says about itself: title, description, headings, first paragraph, internal links, body words.

name: build
doc: The advisory map for the audited pages: (url, html, internal links on that page), in crawl order.

name: lines
doc: The map as text, shared by the Keywords chapter prompt and MCP get_report(section="keywords").

name: _resources
doc: Flatten bounded table/checklist/subitem locators; never retain HTML or node text.

name: scan_pages
doc: At most five free-quota PSI calls. HTTPX's sync Client supports sharing across worker threads.

name: scan
doc: Homepage compatibility path for existing callers.

name: find
doc: (rule id, secret) pairs, at most PER_RULE per rule.

name: _matches
doc:
Run a keyword rule only in windows around its keyword hits (as gitleaks does). Python's backtracking engine is
slow on the lazy context prefixes these RE2 patterns use; windows keep every scan bounded.

name: verification_token
doc: Per-account token the site owner publishes to prove control of the domain.

name: txt_name
doc: Where the DNS proof lives: a TXT record on _walkthru.<host>, so it never collides with SPF or other TXT records.

name: verify_domain
doc:
True when the owner published the token one of three ways, the same proofs Search Console accepts:
<meta name="walkthru-verification"> on the homepage, /.well-known/walkthru.txt, or a DNS TXT record
`_walkthru.<host>` holding `walkthru-verification=<token>`. Checked again at every run start, never cached.

name: txt_verified
calls: ''.join((part for part in r.split('"') if part.strip())).strip

name: check_cors
doc: One ordinary GET with an Origin header, as MDN Observatory does. Only the answer's headers are read.

name: _peek
doc: Status and the first bytes of one URL, without following redirects or downloading a large file.

name: check_bundles
doc: Same-origin scripts of the page (verified domains only): secrets, library banners and public source maps.

name: _source_map
doc: The source map URL when the bundle names one and it really serves a map (or embeds one inline).

name: check_missing_page
doc: W2: a made-up address that answers 200 with a page is a soft 404.

name: scan
doc: All SEO findings for a homepage. `html` avoids a second fetch when the caller already has it.

name: _required_schema
doc:
Only check Google's actual required fields for supported rich-result types.

Article has no required properties in current Search Central docs, so it is
deliberately absent here. Missing optional fields are not errors.

name: _page
doc: Page findings, hreflang map, internal links, and image URLs to inspect.

name: _image_sizes
doc: HEAD at most 12 same-origin images; absent Content-Length means unmeasured.

name: audit
doc: Use only fetched pages plus bounded same-origin HEADs and canonical reads.

name: note
doc: One line for prompts and reports: status, review date and the primary source.

name: _signup_hidden
doc: A homepage whose only sign-up link sits in the footer: visitors look for it in the header or first screen.

name: _site_checks
doc: Checks that need the whole crawl, not one page (adapted from OpenSEO's audit, MIT; see docs/decisions.md).

name: audit
doc: Audit a small same-origin page set. No forms, probes or browser actions.

name: detect
doc: {"hosting", "framework", "backend", "evidence": {part: why}}; unknown parts are None.

name: label
doc: "Next.js on Vercel with Supabase", or "an unknown stack".

name: subdomains
doc: Hosts under the verified host that the audited pages link to or load from (www. counts as the same site).

name: _address
doc:
Resolve once and connect to that address, so a public name cannot point the handshake at a private one. The
same rule as every scan request (fetch.public_addresses).

name: _accepts_legacy
doc: A handshake that offers only TLS 1.0 and 1.1. False when this machine's OpenSSL cannot offer them at all.

name: dns
doc: (DNS status, answer data) over DNS-over-HTTPS. Status 3 is NXDOMAIN.

name: check_caa
doc: No CAA record on the host or any parent: any certificate authority may issue certificates for the domain.

name: Tab
doc: Minimal DevTools client for one page.

name: Tab.post
doc: Send without waiting. Safe from the event handler, which runs on the reader thread.

name: Tab.wait_loaded
doc: Like the panel's settled(): the page must be fully loaded twice in a row (a navigation may just be starting).

name: Tab.message
doc: Same as chrome.tabs.sendMessage to the injected script, re-injecting after full navigations.

name: Tab.screenshot
doc: Base64 JPEG of the viewport.

name: read
doc:
Snapshot the page once it has stopped changing. A loaded document is not a rendered one: many sites draw
their content, or swap in a theme, a moment after load, and a test user who reads too early sees an empty page
and gives up. Waits until two snapshots in a row agree on the address and the number of controls and, for the
first read, until there is at least one control. Gives up waiting after `limit` seconds and returns what is there.

name: _kill
doc: Chrome is a tree of processes (renderers, GPU, network). Kill all of them, never leave one behind.

name: browser
doc: A fresh headless browser with one blank page. The process and its profile are gone when the block ends.

name: Guard.refusal
doc: None when the request may go out, else the reason.

name: install
doc: Call before the first navigation. Also denies downloads and names Walkthru in the user agent.

name: label
doc: A short name for the action, from the page's own (already masked) control text. Never model text.

name: _frame
doc: Capture the viewport with form values hidden, and store it. Returns the visible error boxes (R-S19).

name: _decide
doc:
Ask for the next step, waiting out a busy model. The free models allow a few thousand tokens a minute each, and
a headless browser steps faster than a person's tab, so the whole chain can be busy for some seconds. The
extension retries the same request in that case; so does this. The pending action is untouched by a failed
call, so asking again cannot repeat a click.

name: _last_frame
doc:
A run that ends on a step with no frame (the test user gave up or finished without acting) still shows where
it was: capture that view and attach it to the final step. Best effort.
calls: StepEvidence(screenshot_path=path, captured_at=datetime.now(UTC), result_url=tab.js('location.href'), width=width, height=height, regions=regions, label='Stopped here' if steps[-1].get('action') == 'give_up' else 'Finished here').model_dump

name: run
doc:
Walk one claimed `cloud_runs` row to its end. `hold` extends the lease and reports whether the row is still
ours. Returns the row's final status and, when it did not finish, a plain reason.

name: BodyLimit
doc:
Refuse request bodies over MAX_BODY before anything parses them, and bodies that do not say their size
(chunked uploads), which browsers, the extension and MCP clients never send. The Dodo webhook has its own
tighter limit.

name: _server_error
doc: Any unhandled error: a generic answer for the caller, one line in the founder's admin panel.

name: health
doc:
Up, and the job queue is moving. Without a worker (RETENTION_JOB=0 or JOB_WORKERS=0 on this process and no
`python -m app.jobs` running) runs still finish but their reports never get written, so say so here.

name: ready
doc: Data API read access and queue readiness; not a model, checkpoint-write or whole-application check.

name: _persona
doc: (what the run stores as its test user, the custom prompt or None). Custom test users are Plus only.

name: _group
doc: Several test users per report (Plus): every run in a group must be the caller's, and a group stays small.

name: my_notifications
doc:
Unread counts per sidebar section, and the latest unread items. The Team count adds unread workspace chat and
invitations waiting, which live in their own tables.

name: quote_run
doc:
R-S10: the terms one or more test runs would start under (scope, caps, credits, price version, model route).
The client shows it and sends `token` back with each run; POST /runs refuses stale or different terms.

name: recheck_terms
doc:
R-S13: the owner's latest declared count check on this site, to repeat it like for like from the extension.
The dataset time is left out on purpose: the owner reads the fresh one from the page.

name: my_usage
doc: R-S10 settlement history: each reservation and what happened to its credit and reserved cost.

name: run_usage
doc: What one run used: its settlement in plain language, its stop status and the steps it recorded.

name: run_policy
doc: Asked by the extension before a test: are journeys on for this account? POST /runs enforces it regardless.

name: ignore_finding
doc: Mark a finding as accepted ("won't fix") for this site. It stays in the score but leaves compare lists.

name: get_fix_prompt
doc:
The agent fix prompt as Markdown (paid plans). Built on request, never stored in the report, so the free plan
cannot read it through the report row. `section` limits it to one report chapter (R-S5a).

name: _stop_run
doc: End an interrupted browser session and generate a truthful partial report.

name: _finish_later
doc: Queue the report (app/jobs.py). Only the state finish_run reads goes in the job; of the last page, only its controls.

name: finish_run
doc: After the persona session ends: scans + first impression + synthesis, saved as the report, then email.

name: instant_scan
doc:
Free homepage scan: first impression, SEO basics, security headers. Public report, no login. A current saved scan
of the same page from the last ten minutes is reused and labelled (app/scan_reuse.py) unless `fresh` is set.

name: polite
doc: Count one scan of this site's host. Raises 429 past TARGET_SCANS an hour, so Walkthru never hammers a site.

name: run_scan
doc:
One server-side scan, stored as a run. Anonymous Instant Scans are public; an owner's scan (MCP) is private.
Raises ValueError with a message for the caller when the site cannot be scanned. `dispatch` is the caller's
admission (reservations.work), called once the site answered and right before the first model call.

name: list_test_users
doc: The caller's custom test users; the side panel offers them as `custom:<id>`.

name: get_branding
doc: Saved branding, and whether it applies now: printed reports carry it only while the account is on Plus.

name: create_api_key
doc: The key is returned once and only its hash is stored.

name: _competitors
calls: {(c['name'].lower(), c['domain']): c for c in out}.values

name: add_citation_site
doc: Start tracking a site: suggested prompts come from its homepage, in code; the owner edits them after.

name: check_citations_now
doc: Reserve a bounded batch under the shared free-provider quotas.

name: check_watched_now
doc: Check now, for example right after a deploy. Shares the deploy hook's 10-minute limit.

name: create_deploy_hook
doc: A URL to POST after each deploy (a Netlify deploy notification, a CI step). Shown once; a new one replaces the old.

name: start_compare
doc:
Your site and up to three competitors through the same passive checks, side by side. Deep security checks
never run on sites you have not verified, so competitors only get public checks.

name: github_connect
doc: The GitHub install redirect lands in Settings, which posts its installation id, OAuth code and state here.

name: github_disconnect
doc: Walkthru forgets the installation at once. Uninstalling the App on GitHub also revokes its access there.

name: fix_pull_request
doc: Preview, then open, a pull request with the config-only fixes for this report. The owner reviews and merges it.

name: _badge_run
doc: The embedded report, or the owner's newer public report of the same site, so a rerun updates the badge.

name: badge_link
doc: Where a click on the badge goes: the latest public report for that site.

name: delete_run
doc: Owner deletes one run: screenshots, checkpoint, report and row.

name: export_account
doc: Everything stored about the signed-in user's runs, as one JSON document.

name: delete_account
doc: Permanent. The caller must type their account email to confirm.

name: send_feedback
doc: Signed-in users write to the founder. Stored for the admin panel only; never shown to other users.

name: billing_status
doc: The caller's plan, latest access request, offers and passes. Never product ids or other users' data.

name: _notify_founder
doc:
The `notify_founder` job: errors are retried by the queue. The request is already saved either way
(`scripts/billing.py list` shows it).

name: start_checkout
doc: Open a Dodo checkout for the caller's own approved offer. Paying still grants nothing until the webhook.

name: dodo_webhook
doc: Public, signature-checked. 4xx means never retry (forged or not ours); 5xx asks Dodo to retry later.

name: verification
doc: Token the site owner publishes to unlock the full security scan (exposed files, secrets in bundles).

name: DatabaseUnavailable
doc: Supabase could not be reached or answered with a server error. Mapped to a fast 503.

name: _exact_count
doc: Count in PostgreSQL, independent of PostgREST's response row cap. Never guess zero.

name: begin_provider_attempt
doc: Idempotent receipt acknowledgement, never permission to replay inference.

name: finish_provider_attempt
doc: An identical terminal acknowledgement is safe to retry; conflicting writes fail.

name: reserve_run
doc: R-S8 atomic credit and budget reservation (migrations/0005). Replays of the same key return the same reservation.

name: reserve_work
doc: R-S9 shared admission (migrations/0006): the same ledger and funded budget for every operation.

name: finish_reservation
doc: Identical terminal replays return True; conflicting or impossible transitions return False.

name: reservations_for
doc: The owner's newest reservations (R-S10 usage history), slim and bounded.

name: recent_public_scan
doc:
Reuse only completed anonymous scans, for ten minutes from creation.

Exact URL matching preserves paths and queries. No process cache: deletion or
unsharing takes effect on the next lookup, and every API process sees the same rows.

name: latest_public_scan_id
doc: The newest anonymous free Instant Scan row of this exact URL in any state (app/scan_reuse.py claim generation).

name: mark_run_stopped
doc: Atomically close a running row. False means another request already closed it.

name: run_history_page
doc:
Owner-only slim history, newest first with a deterministic timestamp/id continuation.

Cursor scope does not grant access: the owner filter is present on every database query.
Scores are projected as a scalar; reports, steps and contact fields are never downloaded.

name: test_runs_since
doc: Complete site-only usage history. Continue even when the server caps a page below 500.

name: free_runs_today
doc: Free test runs (or Instant Scans, kind="scan") started today, UTC. Counted in the database, so every API process sees the same number.

name: Conflict
doc: A unique constraint refused the write (for example a second pending access request).

name: _insert
doc: Insert and return the stored row. With `on_conflict`, a duplicate is skipped and None comes back.

name: _update
doc: Conditional update; the returned rows say whether anything matched (compare-and-set).

name: decide_access_request
doc: pending -> approved or rejected, once.

name: mark_offer
doc: Move an offer out of `from_status`. False when another request moved it first.

name: record_billing_event
doc: Store a verified webhook once. Returns the stored row, which is the earlier one on redelivery.

name: grant_paid_entitlement
doc: Insert the pass for an offer. False when that offer already granted one (a retry or a race).

name: _citation_rows
doc: Page bounded reads rather than silently accepting PostgREST's row cap.

name: app_event
doc: Feedback or a server error for the founder's admin panel (apps/api/admin).

name: public_reports
doc: The owner's shared reports, newest first: the badge follows the latest one for its site.

name: recent_reports
doc: The user's latest finished test runs with a report, newest first: candidates for rerun comparison.

name: evidence_objects
doc: Storage paths under each run's folder, through the Storage API.

name: user_email
doc: The account's email from Supabase Auth, read only when a report email is sent.

name: setup
doc: Apply every pending migration (app/migrate.py). Kept so `python -m app.db` still works.

name: statements
doc:
SQL as single statements (tests apply blocks of a migration this way): `--` comment lines dropped, split on semicolons outside $$ bodies, so a
function or DO block keeps its inner semicolons.

name: claim_hook
doc: Atomically record a deploy-hook run unless one ran after `not_before` (the 10-minute rate limit).

name: membership
doc: The caller's member row with its team embedded, or None when they are not a member.

name: update_member
doc: Compare-and-set on one member row; extra `filters` are PostgREST conditions like role="eq.member".

name: team_invites
doc: Invitations not revoked and not expired. Used-up ones are filtered by the caller (uses < max_uses).

name: invites_for_email
doc: Open email invitations addressed to this (verified) address, across workspaces.

name: share_run
doc: False when the run was already shared into this workspace.

name: runs_brief
doc: What workspace pages show of shared runs: no steps or evidence, only the report's findings and score.

name: insert_message
doc: Once per (team, client_id): a retried send returns the message already stored, with `new` False.

name: team_messages
doc: Oldest first. `after` pages forward (live updates); otherwise the latest `limit` messages before `before`.

name: unread
doc: (unread messages in the workspace channel, unread mentions anywhere) by others, each capped at 100.

name: thread_counts
doc: Comments per run and finding thread. ponytail: reads thread names; a grouped count view past ~5,000 comments.

name: messages_by
doc: Every chat message and comment this user wrote, for the account export.

name: enqueue_job
doc: Insert a job unless one with this dedupe key exists, so the transport retry in _request never doubles it.

name: finish_job
doc: Record the outcome, only while this worker still holds the lease (a reclaimed job belongs to its new worker).

name: readiness
doc: Read access to runs and the queue, with short per-phase timeouts and no retry or row-content fetch.

name: oldest_waiting_job
doc: The oldest queued job that has been due for over `seconds`. None means the workers are keeping up.

name: hit_rate_limit
doc: Count one request. 0 when it is allowed, else the seconds until the window ends.

name: hold_cloud_run
doc:
Extend the lease and save progress. False means the row is no longer this runner's: stopped by its owner, or
reclaimed after the lease ran out. The runner must stop acting then.

name: cloud_runs_ahead
doc: How many test users, anyone's, are queued or running before this one.

name: stop_cloud_runs
doc: Queued test users end at once. A running one loses its row here, and its runner closes the journey on its next step.

name: upload_evidence
doc: Store one step frame in the private bucket with the service role (the extension uploads with the user's own token).

name: enqueue
doc: Queue a job. Payloads are plain JSON and hold ids, never emails or tokens. `key` makes the job unique.

name: backoff
doc: Seconds before the next try: 30 s doubling per attempt, at most an hour, with jitter so retries spread out.

name: run_one
doc: Claim and run one due job. False when nothing was due.

name: schedule
doc: Queue each periodic pass once per window. Every process calls this; the dedupe key keeps one job per window.

name: start_background
doc: Worker threads plus the periodic scheduler. ponytail: daemon threads, so a stop mid-job waits out the lease (SD-6.4).

name: current
doc: The caller's plan, its counting window and what they used in it.

name: check_start
doc: Raise a plain-language HTTP error when this run is outside the plan.

name: summary
doc: What the side panel and dashboard show: `GET /me/plan`.

name: normalize
doc: Read numeric allowlists only. Detail channels can overlap totals, not extra bills.

name: estimate
doc:
Versioned standard token list-price baseline, never an invoice/total charge.

Integer micro-USD per million tokens; one final rounding. Reasoning/image/cache
detail counts are not added again to inclusive input/output. Unpriced stays null.

name: scope
doc: Carry only server IDs, including across job leases. Never accept payload text.

name: UsageUnavailable
doc: The pre-dispatch receipt could not be confirmed. No provider call is allowed.

name: observe_gemini
doc:
Observe the existing synchronous SDK request before lossy LC normalization.

Installed langchain-google-genai 4.4.0 calls this public SDK method once per
invoke. No extra request or parsing/routing change. Fakes need no SDK client.

name: initialize
doc: Only opt-in storage needs readiness. Off never contacts the database.

name: attempt
doc:
Wrap circuit admission so receipt writes never change provider health.

Completion writes never trigger inference replay. If they fail, the durable
pending receipt remains unknown for later reconciliation; no usage is fabricated.

name: CircuitOpen
doc: Skip this provider without sleeping or issuing another request.

name: available
doc: Advisory precheck for queues; guard still admits at most one recovery probe.

name: guard
doc:
Wrap provider work only, never database writes or browser/graph mutations.

Count consecutive failed calls in completion order. Old in-flight results cannot close a newer circuit.
Locks protect admission/state only, never network work. ContextDecorator also supports regular functions.

name: terms
doc: The server's current terms for this request. Raises the same plain-language errors as starting would.

name: issue
doc: Sign the terms with an expiry. The token is what the client sends back on acceptance.

name: accept
doc:
Bind a run to its quote: signature, account, expiry, the request's scope and the server's current terms.
Returns the pinned terms; the caller clamps the run to the quote's step cap. Raises 409 when stale or different.

name: describe
doc: One plain-language paragraph, shared by the API, MCP and both clients.

name: explain
doc: One usage record in plain language: what happened to the credit and to the reserved provider cost.
calls: {'refused': 'the goal was refused before the test started', 'failed': 'it failed after starting'}.get

name: reserve
doc: Reserve one run credit and the plan's maximum provider cost. Returns the reservation id (None when off).

name: dispatched
doc: Record that provider work may start. Without this record, no model call is made.

name: release
doc: Return the credit and budget of a run that never dispatched provider work. Failures leave it counted (safe).

name: settle
doc:
Record the run's terminal outcome. An unknown actual cost (None) keeps the reserved maximum counted.
Idempotent: job retries and replays send the identical outcome.

name: work_cost
doc: Maximum provider cost of one unit, integer micro-USD. Every route uses free models today, so 0 until approved.

name: reserve_work
doc:
Reserve `units` of today's allowance and their maximum cost. Returns the reservation id (None when off).
Raises HTTPException when refused or unconfirmed, so nothing is dispatched.

name: work
settle_work
doc: Settle asynchronous work admitted with reserve_work + dispatched (comparison jobs, AI answer batches).

name: goal_ideas_for
doc: Goals this site's own links and buttons support, read from its served pages without a model (app/goal_ideas.py).

name: _card
doc: One test user's state for the live page. Frames are named by path; the page signs them with the owner's session.

name: stop
doc: Queued test users end now. A running one is closed by its runner at its next step, with a partial report.
